query:
SELECT id, title, 
  CASE WHEN titleEn IS NOT NULL AND titleEn != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as hasEnTitle,
  CASE WHEN titleJa IS NOT NULL AND titleJa != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as hasJaTitle,
  CASE WHEN contentEn IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(contentEn) > 100 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as hasEnContent,
  CASE WHEN contentJa IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(contentJa) > 100 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as hasJaContent
FROM posts 
ORDER BY id;
